stackup.policy: L2 and L5 stay continuous GND references. Do not cut a reference plane merely to create an AGND/DGND visual partition. Final dielectric/copper thickness and impedance geometry must come from the selected PCB fabricator before fabrication release.

PRECISION_ANALOG.routing_policy: No switch-node adjacency; minimize layer changes; keep return path continuous.

FAST_SINGLE_ENDED.routing_policy: Route as compact groups over an uninterrupted GND reference, avoid stubs, and minimize vias. Numeric skew limits remain a timing-analysis item rather than an invented fabrication rule.

EXTERNAL_DIFFERENTIAL.routing_policy: Pair-coupled routing from transceiver to protection/connector, no long stubs, no plane split crossing.

critical_placement.rule: Place at a board edge and preserve the physical current-flow order. TVS and input bulk return must be compact.
Each regulator forms a compact local hot loop with its input/output capacitors. Keep SW copper small and away from ADC/DAC/reference nodes.
Keep the LT8330 switching/transfer loop compact and physically separated from precision analog.
Place downstream of switching stages and close to the precision loads they serve; do not route switching nodes beneath them.
Cluster each DAC with its local decoupling and analog output network. Keep digital ingress on the host-facing side and analog egress toward J5.
Keep AD7606C-16, its reference/decoupling and RC network compact. Connector-side ESD precedes the RC/ADC victim in the physical path.
Place SM712 protection adjacent to the external connector, then termination/transceiver. Keep differential loops compact.
Place at accessible board edges and preserve their documented non-safety residual-risk semantics; placement must not imply STO.

rules: Use placement to separate switchers, digital PHY, ADC and DAC domains instead of cutting GND.
Do not route a fast or precision signal across a void in its reference plane.
Add nearby GND stitching vias at every high-speed layer transition.
Keep switching-current return loops local and away from precision analog return paths.
Place connector ESD return vias immediately adjacent to the protection device.
Treat J5 pins 9/10 as signal GND, not chassis or protective earth.

note: These are Layout design rules, not a released PCB-fabricator stackup. Controlled-impedance trace widths/gaps must be recalculated from the selected fabricator stack before Gerber/fabrication authorization.
